_readme: MASTER CONFIG. Single source of truth for MINUTEMAN. Edit here, then run `make all`. Units: inches, degrees, pounds, USD. Tags: FIXED | PARAMETRIC | PRELIMINARY | VERIFY ON TRUCK. Coordinate system: origin on the bed-floor top surface, truck centerline, at the inner face of the bed front wall (bulkhead). +X forward toward the cab, +Y left (driver side), +Z up.

FRAME_SYSTEM.note: ADR 0001. Selects the v0.2+ frame architecture; v0.1 envelope is identical for all three.

TRUCK.note: Truck reference variant shown in the model.

camper_lower_length.label: Lower tub / main body length
camper_lower_length.note: Must fit the shortest supported bed (6.75 ft).

camper_body_width.label: Main body width (above bed rails)
camper_body_width.note: Legal width limit is 102 in; 80 matches cab width for low drag.

camper_lower_tub_width.label: Lower tub width (upper step, between rails)
camper_lower_tub_width.note: Must pass through the tailgate opening and fit between bed sides with clearance.

wheel_well_clearance.label: Tub step clearance above wheel wells

body_rail_clearance.label: Body underside above bed rail top
body_rail_clearance.note: Space for rail caps / rubber spacers.

camper_front_gap.label: Camper front wall to bed front wall gap

camper_to_cab_clearance.label: Nose underside above cab roof
camper_to_cab_clearance.note: Measure over clearance lights / antenna; allow for suspension and cab-bed relative motion.

interior_height.label: Interior clear standing height
interior_height.note: Owner requirement: 6'7" (79 in) person standing. Parametric for sensitivity (ADR 0002).

roof_thickness.label: Roof structure + skin thickness at eave

roof_crown.label: Roof transverse drainage crown at centerline

skin_thickness.label: Exterior skin thickness (5052-H32)
skin_thickness.note: 0.040 on walls is a cost/weight lever (time_cost/cost_reduction_opportunities.md).

nose_projection.label: Nose (cab-over) projection forward of front wall
nose_projection.note: Storage/desk volume only. Not a sleeping platform for two adults.

nose_top_setback.label: Nose front rake: top setback from lower front edge

door_width.label: Rear door rough opening width
door_width.note: Sized to a commercial cargo-trailer / RV door. Final value from the purchased door's datasheet.

window_side_center_above_floor.label: Side window center above interior floor

window_side_center_from_rear.label: Side window center forward of camper rear face

utility_rail_side_heights.label: Side rail centerline heights above interior floor

utility_rail_front_height.label: Front rail centerline height above interior floor

utility_rail_end_inset.label: Rail end inset from interior corners

roof_rack_boss_from_rear.label: Roof-rack boss stations forward of camper rear
roof_rack_boss_from_rear.note: v0.2: each station must coincide with a roof crossmember (ADR 0003).

roof_rack_boss_edge_inset.label: Roof-rack boss inset from body side

power_zone_from_front.label: Reinforced floor zone set back from front interior wall
power_zone_from_front.note: Forward placement keeps mass ahead of the rear axle.

wire_chase_size.label: Wire chase square size (front-left corner, floor to roof)

truck_bed_floor_height.label: Ground to bed floor
truck_bed_floor_height.measure: Truck loaded as it will travel (fuel full, normal tire pressure), level ground. Tape from ground to top of bed floor at the tailgate, both sides; record average.

truck_bed_rail_height.label: Bed floor to top of bed rail (bed depth)
truck_bed_rail_height.measure: Straightedge across the rails; measure down to bed floor at front, middle, rear. Note rail caps if fitted.

truck_bed_floor_width.label: Inside bed width at floor (outside the wheel wells)
truck_bed_floor_width.measure: Across the bed floor ahead of the wheel wells, side wall to side wall, at floor level. Measure at front and at tailgate.

truck_bed_inner_width_top.label: Inside bed width at top of rails
truck_bed_inner_width_top.measure: Inside face to inside face just below the rail lip, front and rear.

truck_bed_rail_width.label: Bed rail top width (each side)
truck_bed_rail_width.measure: Inside lip to outside edge of the bed side, across the top of the rail.

truck_tailgate_opening_width.label: Tailgate opening width (narrowest point)
truck_tailgate_opening_width.measure: Tailgate open or removed. Narrowest clear width between the bed-side posts, including latch strikers.

truck_wheel_well_width.label: Clear width between wheel wells
truck_wheel_well_width.measure: Between the inner faces of the wheel wells at their widest bulge.

truck_wheel_well_height.label: Wheel well height above bed floor
truck_wheel_well_height.measure: Bed floor to the highest point of the wheel-well hump.

truck_wheel_well_length.label: Wheel well length along bed
truck_wheel_well_length.measure: Front to rear edge of the wheel-well hump at floor level.

truck_cab_height_above_bed.label: Bed floor to highest point of cab roof
truck_cab_height_above_bed.measure: Level across from the cab roof (incl. clearance lights, antenna base, roof marker lamps) down to bed floor.

truck_cab_to_bed_clearance.label: Gap: bed front wall outer face to cab back
truck_cab_to_bed_clearance.measure: At rail height and at cab roof height; record the smaller.

truck_bed_front_wall_thickness.label: Bed front wall thickness at the rail
truck_bed_front_wall_thickness.measure: Top of the front rail, inside lip to outside face.

truck_hood_height_above_bed.label: Hood height above bed floor (reference model only)

truck_windshield_run.label: Windshield horizontal run, roof front to hood (reference model only)

truck_front_overhang.label: Front axle to front bumper (reference model only)

truck_body_bottom_below_bed.label: Bed/cab body bottom below bed floor (reference model only)

truck_beltline_above_bed.label: Cab beltline above bed floor (reference model only)

truck_bed_length.label: Bed length at floor (6.75 ft bed)
truck_bed_length.measure: Bed floor, inside front wall to tailgate inner face (tailgate closed).

truck_rear_axle_from_bulkhead.label: Rear axle centerline aft of bed front wall (6.75 ft bed)
truck_rear_axle_from_bulkhead.measure: Drop a plumb line from the hub center; measure along the bed side to the inside of the front wall.

truck_wheelbase.label: Wheelbase, crew cab 6.75 ft (reference model only)

truck_bed_length.label: Bed length at floor (8 ft bed)
truck_bed_length.measure: Bed floor, inside front wall to tailgate inner face (tailgate closed).

truck_rear_axle_from_bulkhead.label: Rear axle centerline aft of bed front wall (8 ft bed)
truck_rear_axle_from_bulkhead.measure: Drop a plumb line from the hub center; measure along the bed side to the inside of the front wall.

truck_wheelbase.label: Wheelbase, crew cab 8 ft (reference model only)

AL6061T6.label: 6061-T6 aluminum
AL6061T6.note: HAZ value is an approximate annealed-zone figure; cite Aluminum Design Manual before CALCULATED use.

TSLOT_1010.note: 80/20 1010 class; 0.5097 lb/ft catalog value (MANUFACTURER VERIFIED pending citation).

estimate_basis._note: First-pass weight coefficients (status CONCEPT). Areas come from the envelope; coefficients are calibrated to PROJECT_HANDOFF.md §2.5 and must be replaced by frame take-offs in v0.2.

floor_lb_per_ft2.note: Floor sandwich + tub structure + node plates.

skin_overlap_factor.basis: skin area x thickness x density

jacks_lb_set.note: Tracked separately from shell dry weight.

power_zone_lb.note: Battery or solar generator; mass + footprint only (ADR 0003).

roof_rack_lb.note: Roof rack + panels, distributed over six bosses.
